# Shared R help topics

`fit.Rd` covers a generic and two methods with different formals, grouped
arguments, and an additional alias for the whole topic.

`eulergram-compose.Rd` is copied from eulerr commit
`8030deb7e6945af178b5717701389da12e036d5a`. It documents two operator methods
under one help alias. The R fixture preserves the maintained signatures and
uses inert bodies. Supporting declarations resolve the topic's local links.
Tests copy these inputs into temporary workspaces before extraction or rendering.
